LESSON: PILLARS OF ISLAM

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: DEVOTIONAL
Topic 5.1: Pillars of Islam

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Pillars of Islam. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which body parts are Wudhu a) Perform Wudhu the two feet) washed during wudhu?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Name the five daily and in order. prayers.  Organize to take learners to a nearby

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Name the five daily and in order. prayers.  Organize to take learners to a nearby
   In simple words: practise until you can name the five daily and in order. prayers.  Organize to take learners to a nearby. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Pillars of Islam using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Pillars of Islam in the examples.
2. Explain Pillars of Islam to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Pillars of Islam.
4. Show that you can: Name the five daily and in order. prayers.  Organize to take learners to a nearby

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pillars of Islam using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Pillars of Islam important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
